subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen upstream GitHub Action revisions for workflows that handle app tokens, publishing, attestation, scanning, and agent credentials?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but approving new executable third-party Action code in privileged workflows is a supply-chain trust decision that cannot be inferred from test success alone.

options.title: Approve reviewed upstream revisions
options.body: Confirm the official full-SHA revisions and their release notes, then update the branch against current main and merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Pause selected action upgrades
options.body: Keep the PR open but split out any action whose release or trust change needs separate owner review.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed upstream revisions
recommendation.body: Confirm the official full-SHA revisions and their release notes, then update the branch against current main and merge after required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository context does not provide defensible named ownership for the affected workflow and supply-chain boundary.
